summary:
Space Time Capsule is an interactive educational project that explores NASA’s discarded and retired space equipment on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space. The project introduces important space missions, including Apollo lunar experiments, the Mars rovers Spirit and Opportunity, and the Voyager spacecraft.

We developed a digital platform that presents the history, purpose, scientific discoveries, and current status of these space technologies in a simple and interesting way. It includes interactive exhibits, easy-to-understand explanations, interesting facts, and quizzes to engage school-age students and space enthusiasts.

Our project addresses the challenge of making the stories of abandoned space equipment accessible and meaningful to young learners. It helps users understand how these instruments contributed to scientific discoveries and why their legacy remains important. By combining storytelling and interactive learning, Space Time Capsule inspires curiosity about space exploration, science, and technology.
details:
Space Time Capsule is an interactive educational website that tells the stories of NASA’s abandoned, retired, and still-travelling space equipment on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space. The project focuses on Apollo lunar experiments, Mars rovers Spirit and Opportunity, and Voyager 1 and 2.

Our website allows users to explore different space missions, understand the purpose of scientific instruments, discover important achievements, and learn about their current status through simple explanations, interesting facts, and interactive quizzes.

We developed the prototype using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. HTML structures the content, CSS creates an attractive and user-friendly design, and JavaScript provides interactive features such as exhibit selection and quizzes.

The main benefit of this project is making space science and exploration interesting and accessible to school students and young space enthusiasts. It preserves the stories of important space missions and encourages curiosity about science and technology.

Our creative approach combines storytelling, interactive learning, and space exploration history in one digital platform. We considered simplicity, accessibility, educational value, and user engagement while developing the project.
